item.title: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers
item.content:encoded:
Hi, my name is Dylan, also known as Johnnyblushoes, and Ive known about the scp foundation, but thanks to a battle with horror triggered ocd that i"ve thankfully gotten a hold of with therapy, I figured I might join this and the other site to see what's up monthly question wise, its usually either involving trying to get through school, or where to start as a game developer. Anywho, I already have a few ideas for this and the sister site once i look at it, so see yall around!
Side note: is it okay if i use my own doctor/researcher guy so as to not step on anyone's toes?

item.title: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers
item.content:encoded:
Howdy! I stumbled upon the Foundation a few years ago via a simple google search. (Who would've thought?) Since then, the Foundation has endlessly inspired me and I regularly discuss it with the handful of fellow skippers I know in real life. I'm so grateful that I actually took the time to become a member.

Currently, I plan to read, comment, vote and–when I have a little more experience under my belt–review. Me and my friend (who, despite my best efforts, is not yet a member of this site) have an idea for an SCP in the works, but it's still in the very early stages.

For the monthly question: I often lay awake at night, pondering my future career. Also, I must confess that I have a habit of watching SCP Illustrated immediately before bed, and I'm sure you can imagine how that turned out.

Overall, I am extremely happy and proud to call myself a member of this amazing site! See you around!

item.title: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers
item.content:encoded:
Hello everyone, I am so excited to at long last join the SCP community! I've been aware of SCP for quite a long time and last year was my deep dive into the wiki itself. I've always wanted to discuss my favorite skips and rate them. I hope in the future I'll get around writing something, but for now I'll stick to reading; it's always been one of my favorite hobbies!

For the monthly question: I often wonder how my future will turn out. In most nights however, I wonder how humanity's future will turn out.

For the monthly question: I usually wonder what would have happened if acted differently on various events of my life.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers
item.content:encoded:
Note: If you're going to introduce yourself here, please scroll down and click "New Post" and NOT "reply", otherwise your comment will nest incorrectly!

Hello, readers and reviewers of the Foundation Universe!

This month's random question is: what kind of random thoughts keep you up at night?

Let's start off with some things to take a look at to enhance your reading, now that you're a site member:

  • If you have any questions about the Foundation'verse and its various individuals and groups of interest, head over to the Foundation Universe forum to talk about the various aspects of living/working/being in constant fear of a world where anomalies are real.
  • Did you know our site has a night mode version? If you're interested in that (and a few other neat things!), check out our Usertools page.
  • Want to leave a comment or read others' thoughts on something you've read recently? Scroll down to the bottom of that page you read, click the "Discuss" link, and take a look at the comments others have posted!

For those looking to put your knowledge of the SCP-verse to work and contribute to the site by helping develop works-in-progress, head on over to the Writing Help forums!

  • So you want to be a concept reviewer?
  • So you want to be a draft reviewer?
  • And of course, remember the Criticism Policy!

If you're not sure what to talk about here, you can take a look at our How to Write an Intro/Welcome thread for ideas.

Go ahead and respond to other new members if you find that your interests overlap, and definitely ask for reading suggestions if there's a particular kind of SCP article or tale you enjoy reading. If you're looking to get started as a critiquer, feel free to mention the kind of material you particularly want to see more of on the wiki! You might even see some of our authors drop by here from time to time, if you mention you liked their work! :)

Welcome to the site!
